notes.title: Meet Lootbound — our new roguelite adventure!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

We’re thrilled to finally introduce you to our next project — [b]Lootbound[/b]. It’s a pixel-art, top-down roguelite RPG with turn-based combat, party building, and a heavy focus on inventory management. This time, you’re not diving into a dungeon — you’re trying to escape with your loot, your team, and your life. Every run is shaped by dice rolls, risky decisions, and that one cursed sword you probably should’ve left behind.

Lootbound is a special game for us. It’s built with a lot of love (and coffee), and we’re pouring everything we’ve learned into it. The game is still in development, but we couldn’t wait any longer to share it with you. For now, we’re posting sneak peeks to give you a first look at the world we’re building — and we’ll be dropping regular dev updates along the way. Stick with us — we’re just getting started, and we promise it’ll be worth the wait.

Cheers,

The ArtDock Team
